tool.name: build-gem5.opt-riscv
tool.description: Build RISC-V with Ruby CHI using SCons and all cores

option.name: PARAMETERS
option.value: -c "import os import subprocess import sys commands = [ ['scons', 'defconfig', 'build/RISCV', 'build_opts/RISCV'], ['scons', 'setconfig', 'build/RISCV', 'RUBY=y', 'PROTOCOL=CHI', 'RUBY_PROTOCOL_CHI=y', 'RUBY_PROTOCOL_MI_example=n'], ['scons', '-j', str(os.cpu_count() or 1), 'build/RISCV/gem5.opt', 'build/RISCV/compile_commands.json'], ] for command in commands: print(' '.join(command), flush=True) result = subprocess.run(command) if result.returncode: sys.exit(result.returncode)"

tool.name: clean-gem5.opt-riscv
tool.description: clean RISC-V with Ruby CHI using SCons
